decisions.quote: Though low-cost value affirmation interventions have been shown to reduce achievement gaps in some classroom settings, these findings have not been consistently replicated. In this study, we test the efficacy of this intervention among a new sample of students enrolled in a community college in the Midwest.
decisions.reason: The primary source file (47a8be34f8916560.txt, Baker, Skinner, & Redding, DOI 10.1080/00221546.2019.1650582) contains only the title and a 6-sentence abstract with no in-text citations, methods/results comparisons, or reference list. While the abstract states that low-cost value affirmation interventions have been shown to reduce achievement gaps in some classroom settings and tests the efficacy of this intervention in a new community college sample, it does not name any specific original study. Consequently, it cannot be verified from the available source text which specific published work is empirically retested or whether the unnamed candidate in target_index 0 is already represented by shipped row 302 (Cohen, Garcia, Apfel, & Master, 2006, Science, DOI 10.1126/science.1128317) versus a distinct omitted original study. Prior adjudication and state files were checked and do not exist.
